This is the official youtube channel of Veterinary Students For Animal Welfare(VET-SAW).

Veterinary Students for Animal Welfare (Vet-SAW) is a student-led non-profit organization that works
to inform, educate, and aware the community about the basic welfare needs of animals by building and improving the bridge between veterinary professionals and the public.
It aims to uplift animal welfare by organizing, educating, and involving emerging veterinarians in the veterinary profession.
Established in 2018, Vet-SAW has been continuously working to build a community of a youth-led and motivated group of veterinary students who constantly advocate and promote the importance of animal welfare to ensure healthier and longer life of animals. Vet-SAW strongly believes in building a society where both human and the animal can co-exist and thrive in
their best way.
